snippet.title: Introducing Revenue Hub | Connected CPQ, Billing and Payments
snippet.description:
Revenue workflows live in fragmented point solutions, separate from your customer records, and every team pays the price. Deals stall, renewals get missed, and finance closes from different numbers than sales. Agents could fix this, but they lack revenue data, too. The next generation of revenue teams will run on agents and humans working together from a complete picture of every customer. Most teams don't have that yet.

Revenue Hub is your team's command center for quotes, billing, and payments. Because revenue context finally lives where your customer data does, your HubSpot AI can work from first prompt to final payment: Breeze Assistant helps reps build quotes from simple chat prompts and surfaces upsells and renewals automatically, Customer Agent handles billing questions, and Revenue Agent (coming soon) follows up on overdue invoices, so your team can focus on compounding revenue instead of chasing it.

Start 14-Day Free Trial: https://www.hubspot.com/revenue

snippet.title: Four Growth Opportunities for Partners in the AI Turn | HubSpot
snippet.description:
AI isn't replacing partner services, it's creating unprecedented demand. Here's where the biggest opportunities are.

*Access insights shaping the future of partner ecosystems in HubSpot's State of Ecosystems Report.* 🔗 https://www.hubspot.com/state-of-ecosystems

AI isn't replacing partner services—according to IDC, it's increasing demand for them.
In HubSpot’s first-ever State of Ecosystems Report, Angie O'Dowd, Global Vice President of HubSpot's Partner Ecosystem, shares why leading technology companies are investing billions into partner ecosystems and what that means for partners looking to grow in the AI era.

You'll learn:
• Why IDC projects a $42 billion HubSpot partner opportunity by 2030
 • How HubSpot's agentic customer platform is foundational to customer value
 • Four key growth areas for partners: Mid-Market Expansion, Agentic Acceleration, Marketing Transformation, and Specialized Expertise
 • Why customer value, openness, and trust are the pillars of the next generation of ecosystems
The data is clear: the partners who move first will define customer value in the AI era—and build enduring businesses along the way.

snippet.title: Why Every Major AI Company Is Betting Billions on Partners | Zack Kass
snippet.description:
Why are AI leaders investing billions in partners? Zack Kass explains the biggest opportunity emerging in the AI era.

*Access the report* 🔗 https://www.hubspot.com/state-of-ecosystems

AI is advancing faster than businesses can adopt it. 

According to Zack Kass, AI futurist, author, keynote speaker, and former Head of Go-to-Market at OpenAI, the gap between what's available and what's useful has never been wider. And that gap is creating one of the greatest opportunities partners have ever seen.

In this foreword to HubSpot's first-ever State of Ecosystems Report, Zack shares why trust, context, and proof have become the foundation of successful ecosystems, and what partners must do now to help customers navigate the AI era.

The internet is evolving from a system of information to a system of action. The partners who move first to help customers adapt will shape the next generation of business growth.

snippet.title: Google Performance Max: Find More High-Value Customers With HubSpot
snippet.description:
Use your CRM to power Google’s AI and reach your next best customers - automatically.
*Click the link to learn more about Google Performance Max* 🔗 https://knowledge.hubspot.com/ads/create-google-search-ad-campaigns-in-hubspot

Want to find more prospects who look exactly like your best customers? In this video, our host Angel shows you how to bridge the gap between your CRM data and your ad spend using Google’s Performance Max integration inside HubSpot. You’ll learn how to use your first party data to train Google’s AI to find your next best customers across YouTube, Gmail, Search, and Maps. Stop chasing low quality clicks and start using HubSpot’s intelligence to drive real revenue impact.

Together, HubSpot and Google Ads offer spend-based incentives that vary based on eligibility and are determined by Google. Incentives mentioned in the video may differ from what you receive.

If you want to follow along or build your own campaign after watching, we’ve linked a step by step knowledge base article (https://knowledge.hubspot.com/ads/create-google-search-ad-campaigns-in-hubspot) and a Performance Max implementation guide (https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/%5BFINAL%5D%20HubSpot%20&%20Google%20Ads%20%20PMax%20Implementation%20Guide.pdf?;utm_medium=Dan-programera&;utm_campaign=SK&;utm_content=ITA_microsoft-development-program&%3Butm_medium=Dan-programera&%3Butm_campaign=SK&%3Butm_content=ITA_microsoft-development-program)

snippet.title: HubSpot is the first CRM to launch a connector for Claude
snippet.description:
Get visualized insights tailored to you by connecting Claude’s reasoning capabilities with your unique HubSpot context: https://clickhubspot.com/2e3dea

*Learn more on YouTube:*
Marketing Hub: https://youtu.be/J5ALoluwVFY
Sales Hub: https://youtu.be/79b4B1iVsF8
Service Hub: https://youtu.be/TOg5ZKD40uE

HubSpot is the first CRM to launch a connector for Claude. 
With this new connector, customers can bring their HubSpot context into Claude for personalized AI insights that drive better action back in HubSpot. 
By connecting Claude's reasoning capabilities with unique HubSpot context, users get customized responses tailored to their needs.
Customers can also visualize the insights through different styles of charts and graphs, and then take action in HubSpot. 

Use cases:
- Marketing teams can ask Claude to find contacts who opened a recent email campaign but didn’t click through, and generate a pie chart to support follow-up segmentation.
- Sales teams can ask for a summary of active deals organized by name, amount, and stage, and sorted by closing date to help prioritize the week.
Support reps can ask for all open tickets assigned to them, sorted by priority and creation date.
- Customer success teams can ask Claude to compare resolution approaches and outcomes across support channels to drive consistency and quality.
The HubSpot connector for Claude will be available to all HubSpot customers across all tiers who have a paid Anthropic subscription (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise).

snippet.description:

Marketing Hub: https://youtu.be/_n3baXRqWT4
Sales Hub: https://youtu.be/WGtm6iQOGYo
Service Hub: https://youtu.be/O68TMWHtNwA

HubSpot is the first CRM to launch a deep research connector with ChatGPT. Customers can now bring their customer context into the HubSpot deep research connector and take action on the insights. 

Now you can do truly remarkable things for your business. 
• Marketing Teams can find highest-converting cohorts and create tailored nurture sequences, then use the insights to launch automated workflows in HubSpot.
• Sales Teams can effortlessly analyze deal pipelines, identify at-risk opportunities, and receive AI-guided suggestions for next steps to close deals faster.
• Customer Success Teams can quickly surface inactive companies, identify expansion opportunities, and receive targeted plays to re-engage pipeline, then take those actions in the Customer Success Workspace in HubSpot to drive retention.

For the first time ever, get the power of ChatGPT, fueled by your CRM data, with no complex setup. The HubSpot deep research connector will automatically be available to all HubSpot accounts across all tiers who have a ChatGPT Team, Enterprise, or Edu subscription. Turn on the HubSpot deep research connector in ChatGPT to get powerful, PhD-level insights from your customer data.

snippet.title: Introducing Guide Creator: Step-by-Step Guides from Screenshots
snippet.description:
Try out the public beta here: https://clickhubspot.com/her

HubSpot is excited to announce the release of Guide Creator, a free tool that helps you create step-by-step guides with screenshots. Whether you need to demo a feature in your product for a prospect, create a guide for customers in your Knowledge Base, or document a process for your employees, Guide Creator has you covered.

To use Guide Creator, install the Google Chrome Extension and start a new capture. Guide Creator captures screenshots as you click and navigate around webpages, and focuses each screenshot on the exact place you click so steps are clear for readers. You can pause, restart, capture your entire screen, or cancel at any time from the Guide Creator menu at the bottom left of your screen. Once you're satisfied, complete the capture, and you'll be taken to the guide editor where you can change the the title, add descriptions, or reorder steps in your newly created step-by-step guide. Finally, you can share your guide with the world or create a private link to share internally at your organization.

All guides are saved within your Guide Creator account so you can return to them at any time!

snippet.title: HubSpot Spotlight: Dharmesh Shah | INBOUND 2023
snippet.description:
ChatSpot: https://clickhubspot.com/fqj
Connect.com: https://clickhubspot.com/rqz

Dharmesh Shah, co-founder and CTO of HubSpot, discusses the potential of generative AI and its impact on business. He shares his personal journey of falling in love with generative AI and how it has influenced his work at HubSpot. He also discusses the future of AI, including the development of AI agents that can work autonomously to achieve specific goals. Dharmesh emphasizes the importance of data in the age of AI, and how it can be used to personalize customer experiences. He also addresses common fears that AI will replace jobs, arguing that AI will instead enhance jobs by reducing mundane tasks and fostering creativity.

snippet.title: HubSpot Spotlight: Andy Pitre | INBOUND 2023
snippet.description:
HubSpot's New AI Tools: https://clickhubspot.com/qd0
HubSpot Sales Hub: https://clickhubspot.com/cz6
HubSpot Commerce Hub: https://clickhubspot.com/473 

In this video, HubSpot's Executive VP, Product, Andy Pitre, discusses the changing landscape of customer engagement and introduces several new features and products designed to help companies adapt. He highlights the challenges of keeping up with customer expectations and the growing importance of AI in business operations. Andy introduces HubSpot AI, a collection of AI capabilities across the customer platform, including assistants to help people work faster, agents to automate work, predictive insights, and ChatSpot. 

Andy also introduces the new Sales Hub, Commerce Hub, new Help Desk and Support Assistant in the Service Hub, and new CRM UI extensions for customization. 

Finally, he highlights the strength of the HubSpot ecosystem, which includes 1500 apps and integrations, over 6000 solution partners, and 3.2 million people in the HubSpot community.

snippet.title: 18 New Sales Hub Features You Should Know! | HubSpot [INBOUND 2023]
snippet.description:
Get started with HubSpot's Sales Hub for free: https://clickhubspot.com/2rj

Sales Hub unites all data, tools, and teams in one place. It provides a comprehensive workspace for sales representatives, allowing them to manage tasks, sequences, leads, and schedules. The software includes a new lead management tool that allows reps to work their leads effortlessly and a sales to sales handoff feature for seamless scheduling of meetings. It also offers a lead form routing tool for automatic qualification and routing of leads. The software has a sequences tool that provides analytics for optimizing outreach based on actual revenue outcomes. It also provides comprehensive reports on prospecting activities, deal management, and lead reporting. The software includes a mobile app that allows reps to engage and nurture their leads on the go.

snippet.title: Introducing Guide Creator: Step-by-Step Guides from Screenshots
snippet.description:
Try out the public beta here: https://clickhubspot.com/xy0

HubSpot is excited to announce the release of Guide Creator, a free tool that helps you create step-by-step guides with screenshots. Whether you need to demo a feature in your product for a prospect, create a guide for customers in your Knowledge Base, or document a process for your employees, Guide Creator has you covered.

To use Guide Creator, install the Google Chrome Extension and start a new capture. Guide Creator captures screenshots as you click and navigate around webpages, and focuses each screenshot on the exact place you click so steps are clear for readers. You can pause, restart, capture your entire screen, or cancel at any time from the Guide Creator menu at the bottom left of your screen. Once you're satisfied, complete the capture, and you'll be taken to the guide editor where you can change the the title, add descriptions, or reorder steps in your newly created step-by-step guide. Finally, you can share your guide with the world or create a private link to share internally at your organization.

All guides are saved within your Guide Creator account so you can return to them at any time!

snippet.title: Summarize contact records (CRM), YouTube videos and podcasts with ChatSpot | HubSpot
snippet.description:
Start chatting with ChatSpot for free now: https://clickhubspot.com/25x

In this ChatSpot update, Dylan Sellberg, Director of Product at HubSpot, brings you a whirlwind of exciting updates:

Summarize CRM Records: A data-filled CRM is a healthy CRM. The more data you have though, the more difficult it can be to extract the most relevant insights. Think about the time it can take to navigate to a record, review important properties, and digest notes from several teammates, it's far from trivial. ChatSpot now supports CRM record summaries to give you those insights in a flash. Just ask ChatSpot to summarize a contact based on their email or a company based on their domain name. ChatSpot will instantly pull some key property data as well as perform an AI powered summary of the history of notes logged to that record. This is truly powerful AI for business that you won't find from any CRM or standalone AI product in the world other than ChatSpot.

P.S. The best part about this update is that since recording the weekly video, we've already made multiple improvements to the way results are returned for contact & company summaries.

Interface Improvements: ChatSpot looks a bit different today. We've made changes that will help scale the product and support increasingly diverse use cases and functionality. Specifically, we've separated Templates and Chat, giving each experience dedicated real estate. With this, we'll have more real estate to improve the fidelity and experience of Chat and also to add additional templates and template-related functionality over time. Additionally, we've introduced a more in-line conversational experience to using prompt templates. 

Summarize YouTube Videos: ChatSpot can now summarize the entire contents of a YouTube video for you in seconds. Need help catching up with the news on Superconductors? ChatSpot has your back. Imagine being the most prepared you've ever been for a meeting...every time. Use ChatSpot to prepare for your next demo meeting or an introduction with a prominent person (or anyone with content on YouTube) in seconds. Just drop the link for some of their YouTube content into ChatSpot and it'll deliver you a dossier of insights.

Summarize Podcast Stats: Podcasts have sure come a long way, I remember downloading standalone episodes to my iPod Classic from iTunes when there were only a handful worth listening to. Now, they're a dominant form of media and can play a key role in your brand's strategy. ChatSpot can help you instantly deep dive on the performance of podcasts that can be relevant to your brand with viewership numbers, publish frequency, and much more. Just ask ChatSpot for some podcast stats and it'll take care of the rest.
